goal.en: Ask the price, get a friendly discount and buy two sea-glass keychains as gifts.
goal.zh: 問價錢、客氣地談個折扣，買兩個海玻璃鑰匙圈當伴手禮。

background: outdoor harbor market stall with a striped canvas roof, wooden table covered with sea-glass jewelry and keychains in small baskets, fishing nets, boats in the water behind, sunny morning

intro.en: The next morning, the harbor market is full of stalls. You want to bring something home for your family.
intro.zh: 隔天早上，港邊市集擺滿了攤位。你想帶點東西回家給家人。

intro.en: Kai, look! Sea-glass keychains. Your family would love these.
intro.zh: 凱，你看！海玻璃鑰匙圈。你家人一定會喜歡。

lines.en: Morning! Everything here is handmade. Take your time.
lines.zh: 早安！這裡每樣東西都是手工做的，慢慢看。

choices.en: They're so pretty. How much is this one?
choices.zh: 好漂亮。請問這個多少錢？
choices.tip: How much is this one? 是問價錢最自然的說法，指著商品說 this one 就很清楚。

choices.en: They're so pretty. This one how much money?

lines.en: How much money is in it? None, friend. It's a keychain, not a wallet.
lines.zh: 裡面有多少錢？一毛都沒有啦，朋友。這是鑰匙圈，不是錢包。

story.en: Benny spends five minutes showing you that the keychain has no secret pocket. You still don't know the price.
story.zh: 班尼花了五分鐘證明鑰匙圈沒有暗袋。你還是不知道它多少錢。

fail.why: 「這個多少錢」照中文字序說成 This one how much money? 不是英文句子。要說 How much is this one?

choices.en: Okay, how much? And don't give me the tourist price.
choices.zh: 好，多少錢？不要給我觀光客價喔。

lines.en: Tourist price? Everyone pays the same here. It's written right on the basket.
lines.zh: 觀光客價？這裡每個人付的都一樣，價錢就寫在籃子上。

story.en: You look down and see the price clearly on the basket. Benny serves the next customer first.
story.zh: 你低頭一看，價錢清清楚楚寫在籃子上。班尼先去招呼下一位客人了。

fail.why: 一開口就暗示老闆會坑觀光客，等於指控對方不老實，很失禮。先客氣地問 How much is this one?

lines.en: That one's twelve dollars. I collect all the glass myself on the beach.
lines.zh: 那個十二元。所有的玻璃都是我自己在海邊撿的。

choices.en: It's lovely. Could you do a better price?
choices.zh: 真的很美。價錢可以再好一點嗎？
choices.tip: Could you do a better price? 是客氣的殺價說法，先稱讚商品再問，語氣更好。

choices.en: It's lovely. Can you count it cheaper for me?
choices.zh: 真的很美。可以算我便宜一點嗎？

lines.en: Count it cheaper? Okay... one, two, twelve. Still twelve dollars.
lines.zh: 算便宜一點？好……一、二、十二。還是十二元。

story.en: Benny counts very carefully, and the number does not change. Mia pretends to look at bracelets.
story.zh: 班尼非常認真地數，數字一點也沒變。米亞假裝在看手鍊。

fail.why: 「算我便宜一點」的「算」不能翻成 count。要說 Could you do a better price? 或 Can you give me a discount?

choices.en: Twelve? No way. Five dollars, final offer.
choices.zh: 十二？不可能。五元，最後出價。

lines.en: Five? Friend, that glass took me a whole week to find.
lines.zh: 五元？朋友，那塊玻璃我找了整整一個禮拜。

story.en: Benny gently takes the keychain back and puts it in the basket. Your final offer was very final.
story.zh: 班尼輕輕把鑰匙圈拿回去，放回籃子裡。你的最後出價，真的成了最後。

fail.why: 在國外市集可以客氣地問折扣，但直接砍到一半以下，對手工藝品攤主很失禮。說 Could you do a better price? 讓老闆自己開價。

lines.en: Tell you what. If you buy two, I'll make it twenty for both.
lines.zh: 這樣吧。買兩個的話，兩個算你二十元。

choices.tip: I'll take two. 是決定購買的固定說法，take 在這裡就是「買」。

choices.en: Great! So one is ten? I'll take one.
choices.zh: 太好了！所以一個十元？那我買一個。

lines.en: No, no. Twenty is for two. One is still twelve.
lines.zh: 不不不，二十元是兩個的價錢。一個還是十二元。

story.en: Benny explains the deal three times with his fingers. Mia buys the second keychain just to end the lesson.
story.zh: 班尼用手指把優惠解釋了三遍。米亞為了結束這堂課，自己買了第二個。

fail.why: If you buy two, I'll make it twenty for both. 是「買兩個才有優惠」，不是單價變十元。要接受就說 Deal! I'll take two.

choices.en: Deal! I will taking two of them.

lines.en: You will be taking them... later? Should I keep them for you?
lines.zh: 你之後會……來拿？要我先幫你留著嗎？

story.en: Benny puts the keychains aside for later. You forget all about them, and they are still waiting for you today.
story.zh: 班尼把鑰匙圈留起來等你。你完全忘了這件事，它們到今天都還在等你。

fail.why: will 後面要接原形動詞，不能接 V-ing。當場決定買就說 I'll take two.。

lines.en: Want me to wrap them? Glass can break in a suitcase.
lines.zh: 要幫你包起來嗎？玻璃放在行李箱裡可能會破。

choices.en: Yes, please. They're gifts for my family.
choices.zh: 好，麻煩你。這是要送家人的禮物。
choices.tip: 被問要不要包裝時，Yes, please. 再補一句用途，老闆會包得更用心。

choices.en: Yes, please help me package them.

lines.en: Package them? You want me to mail them somewhere? That's eighteen dollars for shipping.
lines.zh: 寄包裹？你要我幫你寄到哪裡嗎？運費十八元喔。

story.en: The shipping costs almost as much as the keychains. Your family gets the gifts two weeks after you get home.
story.zh: 運費差不多跟鑰匙圈一樣貴。你回家兩週後，家人才收到禮物。

fail.why: 中文的「包裝」不要直接說 package，package 當名詞常指「包裹」。要說 Could you wrap them? 或直接回答 Yes, please.

choices.en: Obviously. Glass breaks really easily, you know.
choices.zh: 廢話。玻璃很容易破，你知道吧。

lines.en: I do know. I just told you that.
lines.zh: 我知道啊。我剛剛才跟你說過。

story.en: Benny wraps the keychains in silence. Mia buys him a coffee as an apology.
story.zh: 班尼默默包好鑰匙圈。米亞買了一杯咖啡請他，當作賠罪。

fail.why: Obviously 加上 you know 聽起來像在嫌對方問了笨問題。對方好意提議時，說 Yes, please. 加上感謝就好。

lines.en: Here you go. Two keychains, wrapped with love. Twenty dollars, please.
lines.zh: 給你。兩個鑰匙圈，用心包好了。一共二十元。

lines.en: Your family is going to love these, Kai.
lines.zh: 凱，你家人一定會很喜歡。

story.en: You walk away with two little pieces of Port Aurora, a fair price and a new friend at the market.
story.zh: 你帶著兩小塊極光港、一個公道的價錢，還在市集交到一個新朋友。

notes.explain: 問價錢用 How much is...? 複數商品用 How much are these?。不要照中文字序說 This one how much money?

notes.en: Could you do a better price?
notes.explain: 「算我便宜一點」的「算」不是 count。客氣地殺價可以說 Could you do a better price? 或 Is there a discount if I buy two?

example.en: Is there a discount if I buy two?

notes.explain: 市集和手工攤位通常可以客氣地問一次折扣，但不要一開口就砍半，也不要暗示老闆坑人。百貨公司和連鎖店則是不二價，不要殺價。

example.en: It's lovely. Could you do a better price if I buy two?
example.zh: 真的很美。買兩個的話，價錢可以好一點嗎？

notes.explain: 決定要買時說 I'll take it. 或 I'll take two.，take 在這裡就是「買下」。用 I'll（I will）表示當下的決定。

example.en: I'll take the blue one, please.
example.zh: 我要買藍色那個，麻煩你。

notes.explain: 把禮物包起來是 wrap，gift wrap 是禮品包裝。package 當名詞常指要寄送的「包裹」，說 package them 容易被聽成要寄東西。

example.en: Could you gift wrap this, please?
